title: Imicimbi nabangane
description: Ten short, simple stories about birthdays, parties and friends: a girl's birthday cake for her mother, a boy's new bicycle and a snake on a rock, a ceremony for a new baby, a traditional wedding, a church wedding, a burst pipe at a party, two friends who quarrel and make peace, a thief at a night-time braai, an old class that meets again, and a long journey to a friend's birthday.

lessons.title: Ikhekhe likaGciniwe
lessons.summary: On her mother Gciniwe's birthday in May, ten-year-old Ntombenhle of Umzinto weighs the flour and fat, mixes eggs and milk into a sticky batter, bakes a cake and spreads it, lights four candles on it and is thanked again and again.
lessons.text:
UNtombenhle uneminyaka eyishumi. Uhlala eMzinto nomama wakhe, uGciniwe. NgoMeyi uGciniwe unosuku lokuzalwa. UMeyi uyinyanga emnandi kubo bobabili. UNtombenhle ufuna ukuthokozisa umama wakhe. Ufuna ukumenzela ikhekhe.

Ngosuku lokuzalwa uGciniwe uya emsebenzini ekuseni. UNtombenhle usala yedwa ekhaya. Uvula incwadi yokupheka kagogo wakhe. Uyayithanda le ncwadi, ngoba ukupheka kuyamthokozisa. Incwadi ithi: "Kala impuphu namafutha. Xuba amaqanda amathathu nobisi. Bese uxuba konke ndawonye."

UNtombenhle ukala impuphu. Ukala namafutha. Ukala kahle kakhulu, ngoba ukupheka kudinga ukunaka. Bese uthatha amaqanda amathathu. Uxuba amaqanda nobisi esitsheni esikhulu. Uxuba isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni uxuba konke ndawonye.

Okuxubile kuyanamatha. Kunamathela ezandleni zakhe nasetafuleni. UNtombenhle uyahleka. Uthi: "Ukupheka akulula!" Ufaka isitsha emlilweni. Ulinda ihora lonke.

Ngemuva kwehora uNtombenhle ukhipha isitsha emlilweni. Ikhekhe likhulu futhi limnandi. UNtombenhle ugcoba ikhekhe ngamafutha amnandi. Ugcoba phezulu, ugcoba nasemaceleni. Amafutha ayanamatha eminweni yakhe.

Kusihlwa uNtombenhle ucisha ugesi endlini. Kumnyama. Ubeka amakhandlela amane phezu kwekhekhe. Uwakhanyisa ngokushesha. Amakhandlela akhanyisa itafula lonke.

UGciniwe uvula umnyango. Ubona ukukhanya okuhle etafuleni. UNtombenhle uthi: "Usuku oluhle lokuzalwa, mama!" UGciniwe uyajabula kakhulu. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga, ntombi yami. Ikhekhe lakho liyangithokozisa kakhulu." UNtombenhle ukhanyisa ugesi futhi. Badla ndawonye. UGciniwe uthi futhi: "Ngiyabonga. Ukupheka kwakho kuhle njengokupheka kukagogo wakho." UNtombenhle uthi: "Ngiyabonga, mama. Lolu usuku oluhle lukaMeyi."

Imibuzo:
UNtombenhle ufuna ukuthokozisa ubani?
Ufuna ukuthokozisa umama wakhe, uGciniwe.
UNtombenhle ukala amafutha na?
Kunjalo, ukala amafutha kahle kakhulu.
Okuxubile kuyanamatha na?
Kunjalo, kunamathela ezandleni zakhe nasetafuleni.
UNtombenhle ugcoba ikhekhe ngani?
Ugcoba ngamafutha amnandi.
UGciniwe uthi ngiyabonga na?
Kunjalo, uthi: "Ngiyabonga, ntombi yami."

lessons.title: Ibhayisikili likaSibonelo
lessons.summary: For his July birthday in Nongoma, Sibonelo's father Khethelo gives him a red bicycle; they pump up the tyres, the boy loses his fear and rides fast down the dusty road, and they stop to watch a snake shedding its skin on a rock.
lessons.text:
USibonelo uhlala eNongoma nomndeni wakhe. NgoJulayi kuyabanda eNongoma, kodwa uSibonelo uyajabula. NgoJulayi unosuku lokuzalwa. Ubaba wakhe, uKhethelo, umnika isipho esikhulu. Yibhayisikili elisha, elibomvu!

Amasondo awanawo umoya. UKhethelo uthi: "Woza, Sibonelo. Masifuthe amasondo." Bafutha isondo lokuqala. Bafutha nesondo lesibili. Manje amasondo alungile.

USibonelo ugibela ibhayisikili lakhe okokuqala. Unovalo olukhulu. Uthi: "Baba, ngizokuwa!" UKhethelo uthi: "Ungabi novalo. Ngizokubamba." USibonelo ugibela kancane emgwaqweni. UKhethelo uhamba eduze kwakhe. Ngemuva kwesikhashana uvalo luyaphela. USibonelo ugibela yedwa. Ugibela ngejubane elikhulu. Ijubane liyamjabulisa.

Umgwaqo waseNongoma awulona olula. Unothuli oluningi. Uthuli lugcwala emoyeni ngemuva kukaSibonelo. Uthuli lungena nasezingutsheni zakhe. Kodwa akakhathali. Uqhubeka ngejubane.

Eduze komgwaqo kukhona idwala elikhulu. Phezu kwedwala kulele inyoka. USibonelo uyayibona. Uvalo lubuya. Uyeka ukugibela ngokushesha.

UKhethelo uyafika. Ubheka inyoka. Uthi: "Ungesabi, Sibonelo. Le nyoka iyebuza. Uma inyoka ikhula, iyebuza. Ilahla isikhumba sayo esidala." Inyoka ihamba kancane. Ilahla isikhumba esidala phezu kwedwala, bese ingena otshanini.

USibonelo uxhuma phezu kwedwala elincane. Uxhuma futhi, ufika edwaleni elikhulu. Uxhuma phansi, ubona isikhumba esidala senyoka. Simhlophe futhi silula kakhulu. Uthi: "Baba, ngiyabona. Inyoka iyebuza njengoba wena usho."

Babuyela ekhaya. USibonelo ugibela futhi ngejubane. Akanalo uvalo manje. Uthi: "Baba, lolu usuku olumnandi kakhulu ngoJulayi!"

Imibuzo:
USibonelo unosuku lokuzalwa ngoJulayi na?
Kunjalo, unosuku lokuzalwa ngoJulayi.
Bafutha amasondo na?
Kunjalo, bafutha amasondo omabili.
USibonelo unovalo lapho egibela okokuqala na?
Kunjalo, unovalo olukhulu.
Umgwaqo unothuli na?
Kunjalo, umgwaqo unothuli oluningi.
Inyoka yenzani phezu kwedwala?
Inyoka iyebuza, ilahla isikhumba sayo esidala.

lessons.title: Igama lomufi
lessons.summary: Nonzwakazi of Pietermaritzburg and her mother-in-law Thembisile hold the ceremony that introduces her new baby to the ancestors: a goat is slaughtered, the baby gets the name of his late grandfather and the Mchunu surname, and grandmother brews a root medicine while the mother nurses him.
lessons.text:
UNonzwakazi uhlala eMgungundlovu nomyeni wakhe. Banengane entsha, umfana. Ingane inezinyanga ezintathu. UNonzwakazi uncelisa ingane ekuseni nakusihlwa. Ubisi lukamama lwondla ingane, futhi luyayiphilisa.

Ngolunye usuku kufika unina womyeni wakhe, uThembisile. Uthi: "Isikhathi sifikile. Masenze umsebenzi wokwazisa ingane emadlozini." Isiko lomndeni lithi: uma kuzalwa ingane, umndeni uhlaba imbuzi. Imbuzi iyisipho emadlozini. Ngalolu suku umndeni ukhuluma namadlozi ngengane entsha. Lokhu kuthiwa ukwazisa.

Ekuseni abantu bomndeni bayafika. Amadoda athatha imbuzi emhlophe. Ahlaba imbuzi eduze kwendlu. UThembisile umi ngaphambi kwabo. Ukhuluma namadlozi. Uthi: "Madlozi ethu, bhekani, le yingane entsha yomndeni. Namuhla siyanazisa ngayo." Bonke bathula, balalela. Ekugcineni ukwazisa kuyaphela.

Ubaba womyeni kaNonzwakazi wayenguSiphamandla. USiphamandla washona eminyakeni emibili edlule. Manje ungumufi. UThembisile uthi: "Ingane izothola igama lomufi. Igama layo nguSiphamandla. Isibongo sayo nguMchunu, isibongo sikababa wayo." Umndeni uyajabula. Bonke bathi igama lomufi lizophila futhi enganeni.

Ngemuva kwalokho uThembisile upheka izimpande zesihlahla. Uthi: "Lo muthi wezimpande uyaphilisa. Uzosiza ingane ikhule kahle." Ufaka umuthi wezimpande emanzini, ugeza ingane kancane.

Ingane iyakhala. UNonzwakazi uyayithatha. Uyayincelisa futhi. Ingane iyathula. Ilala ezandleni zakhe. UThembisile ulalela ingane iphefumula. Iphefumula kancane, kahle. Uthi: "Bheka, iyaphefumula kahle. Ingane iyaphila. Ondla ingane yakho kahle, Nonzwakazi."

Kusihlwa umndeni udla inyama yembuzi ndawonye. UNonzwakazi ubheka ingane yakhe. Ucabanga ngomufi, ubaba womyeni wakhe. Uthi enganeni: "Ngizokondla kahle, Siphamandla. Uzokhula ube yindoda enhle njengomufi."

Imibuzo:
UNonzwakazi uncelisa ingane na?
Kunjalo, uncelisa ingane ekuseni nakusihlwa.
Umndeni uhlaba imbuzi na?
Kunjalo, amadoda ahlaba imbuzi emhlophe.
Ingane ithola igama lomufi na?
Kunjalo, igama layo nguSiphamandla.
Isibongo sengane sithini?
Isibongo sayo nguMchunu.
UThembisile upheka yini?
Upheka izimpande zesihlahla, ngoba lo muthi uyaphilisa.

lessons.title: Umshado wakwaKhumalo
lessons.summary: In September Yonela of KwaDukuza marries Nkosikhona, who courted her for two years; the men of the Khumalo family slaughter an ox, the women serve the food, everyone eats and dances, and Yonela's mother sheds tears of joy.
lessons.text:
UYonela uhlala eKwaDukuza. NgoSepthemba uyenda. Uyendela kwaKhumalo. Uzoshada noNkosikhona, indodana yomndeni wakwaKhumalo.

Eminyakeni emibili edlule uNkosikhona waqala ukushela uYonela. Wamshela izinyanga eziningi. Wamshela emgwaqweni, wamshela nasesontweni. UYonela wahleka nje. UNkosikhona akazange ayeke ukumshela. Ekugcineni uYonela wavuma. Manje usuku lomshado lufikile.

Ngosuku lomshado, ngoSepthemba, abalisa bomndeni wakwaKhumalo bahlaba inkabi enkulu. Inkabi imnyama, inezimpondo ezinkulu. Ubaba kaNkosikhona uthatha uphondo olulodwa lwenkabi. Uthi: "Lolu phondo luzohlala endlini yethu. Sizokhumbula lolu suku uma silubona." Abalisa bapheka inyama yenkabi emlilweni. Abalisa bakhuluma, bayahleka eduze komlilo.

Abesifazane bomndeni baphaka ukudla. Baphaka inyama, ummbila nemifino. Baphakela abantu abaningi. Bonke badlela ngaphandle, ngaphansi kwezihlahla. Indawo yokudlela inkulu, futhi inezitsha eziningi. Abantu badla, bayakhuluma, bayahleka. Izingane nazo zidlela ngaphansi kwezihlahla.

Ngemuva kokudla kuqala umculo. UYonela unyakaza kahle ngaphambi kwabantu. Abesifazane bayacula. Abalisa nabo bayanyakaza. Nezingane ziyanyakaza. Bonke bayajabula. UNkosikhona uthi: "Yonela, uyanyakaza kahle kunabo bonke!"

Umama kaYonela uhlala eduze kwendodakazi yakhe. Izinyembezi ziyehla ebusweni bakhe. UYonela uthi: "Mama, ukhalelani?" Umama uthi: "Lezi yizinyembezi zokujabula, ntombi yami. Namuhla uyenda. Uzohlala nomndeni omusha." Bese umama uyahleka. Uthi: "Hamba kahle, ntombi yami. Ukwenda kuyinto enhle."

Kusihlwa uYonela noNkosikhona bahamba bayohlala ekhaya labo elisha. Abantu bomndeni bathi: "Hambani kahle!"

Imibuzo:
UYonela wenda nini?
Wenda ngoSepthemba.
UNkosikhona washela uYonela isikhathi eside na?
Kunjalo, wamshela izinyanga eziningi.
Abalisa bahlaba yini?
Bahlaba inkabi enkulu emnyama.
Abesifazane baphaka ukudla na?
Kunjalo, baphaka inyama, ummbila nemifino.
Umama kaYonela unezinyembezi zani?
Unezinyembezi zokujabula.

lessons.title: Umshado esontweni
lessons.summary: In November Thandolwethu of Tongaat marries Zibusiso in church; her aunt sews her dress and takes it in because she has grown slimmer, the brass bell rings, the minister preaches and reminds them of patience, and they pray under a brass cross.
lessons.text:
UThandolwethu uhlala eTongaat. NgoNovemba uzogana uZibusiso. Umshado wabo uzoba sesontweni elidala lasedolobheni. UThandolwethu uyajabula, kodwa unomsebenzi omningi ngaphambi komshado.

Ugogo wakhe uyakwazi ukuthunga kahle. Uthi: "Ngizokuthungela ingubo yomshado." Ugogo uthunga ingubo emhlophe. Uthunga izinsuku eziningi. Ngolunye usuku uThandolwethu uyayigqoka. Ingubo inkulu kakhulu kuye!

Ugogo uthi: "Uyancipha, ntombi yami. Udla kancane ngoba unovalo ngomshado." UThandolwethu uthi: "Kunjalo, gogo. Ngiyancipha njalo ngesonto." Ugogo uthunga ingubo futhi. Uyenza ibe ncane. Manje ingubo ilungile. Ugogo uthi: "Manje yeka ukuncipha. Udle kahle!"

NgoNovemba usuku lomshado luyafika. Ekuseni konke kungomumo. Ingubo ingomumo. Izimbali zingomumo. Umumo wesonto muhle: lihlanzekile, linezimbali ezimhlophe. Odongeni lwesonto kukhona isiphambano esikhulu sethusi. Isiphambano sethusi siyakhanya elangeni.

Insimbi yethusi iyakhala. Abantu bangena esontweni. UThandolwethu ungena nobaba wakhe. UZibusiso umlindile ngaphambi kwesiphambano.

Umfundisi uyashumayela. Ushumayela ngothando. Uthi: "Uthando aluphelelwa yithemba." Ubakhumbuza ukuthi umshado udinga uthando nokuhlonipha. Ubakhumbuza futhi ukuthi kumele bakhulume njalo. Ubakhumbuza nokuthi kumele basizane. Ngemuva kokushumayela umfundisi uthi: "Masithandaze." Bonke bayathandaza. UThandolwethu noZibusiso bathandaza ndawonye ngaphambi kwesiphambano.

UThandolwethu uthi kuZibusiso: "Namuhla ngiyakugana. Ngiyajabula kakhulu." UZibusiso uthi: "Nami ngiyajabula." Insimbi yethusi iyakhala futhi. Abantu bayacula. NgoNovemba uThandolwethu ugane uZibusiso esontweni elidala.

Imibuzo:
UThandolwethu ugana ubani?
Ugana uZibusiso.
Ubani othunga ingubo yomshado?
Ugogo wakhe uthunga ingubo emhlophe.
Kungani ingubo inkulu kakhulu?
Ingubo inkulu ngoba uThandolwethu uyancipha.
Isiphambano sesonto senziwe ngani?
Isiphambano senziwe ngethusi.
Umfundisi ushumayela ngani?
Ushumayela ngothando, futhi ubakhumbuza ukuthi umshado udinga uthando nokuhlonipha.

lessons.title: Ipipi eliqhumile
lessons.summary: At Phiwe's party in Pinetown an old pipe under the roof bursts and water runs everywhere; his friend Sbongiseni shuts off the water and saves the food, they wipe up the wet dirt, and the party carries on outdoors under the stars.
lessons.text:
UPhiwe uhlala ePinetown. NgoMgqibelo wenza umcimbi omncane endlini yakhe. Abangane bakhe abaningi bayafika. Umngane wakhe omkhulu, uSbongiseni, ufika kuqala. Abangane bayacula, bayadla, bayahleka.

Endlini kaPhiwe kukhona ipipi elidala lamanzi. Ipipi likhona ngaphansi kophahla, ngaphezu kwetafula. Ebusuku abantu badla ukudla etafuleni. Ngaleso sikhathi ipipi liyaqhuma! Umsindo mkhulu. Abantu bayethuka.

Amanzi ehla ophahleni. Ehla nxazonke: etafuleni, phansi, ezihlalweni. Abantu bayagijima nxazonke. Izingubo zabo zimanzi. Izinwele zabo zimanzi. Itafula limanzi.

UPhiwe uthi: "Hhayi! Ipipi liqhumile!" Lokhu kuyamkhathaza kakhulu. Ubusuku bakhe obumnandi buyaphela. Kodwa uSbongiseni uthi: "Ungakhathazwa yilokhu, Phiwe. Ngizokusiza." USbongiseni ugijimela ngaphandle. Uvala amanzi. Amanzi ayeka ukwehla ophahleni.

Bese uSbongiseni uhlenga ukudla. Uthatha izitsha zokudla etafuleni elimanzi. Uhlenga inyama, isinkwa nemifino. Ubeka konke endaweni eyomile. UPhiwe uthi: "Uhlengile ukudla kwethu! Ngiyabonga, mngane wami."

Phansi kukhona amanzi nokungcola. Ukungcola kuvela ezicathulweni zabantu. Abangane bathatha izindwangu. Basula phansi. Basula itafula. Basula nezihlalo. Ukungcola kuyaphela. Manje kuhlanzekile, kodwa phansi kumanzi. USbongiseni uyahleka, uthi: "Sizolukhumbula lolu suku!"

USbongiseni uthi: "Masiphume siye esobala! Izulu lihle ebusuku." Bonke baphuma, bahlala esobala ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi. Esobala kumnandi kakhulu. Badla ukudla uSbongiseni akuhlengile. Bayacula futhi. Ubusuku abuphelanga. UPhiwe uthi: "Ipipi liqhumile, kodwa abangane bami bangihlengile. Lokhu akungikhathazi manje."

Imibuzo:
Ipipi likuphi endlini kaPhiwe?
Likhona ngaphansi kophahla, ngaphezu kwetafula.
Amanzi ehla nxazonke na?
Kunjalo, ehla etafuleni, phansi nasezihlalweni.
Ubani ohlenga ukudla?
USbongiseni uhlenga ukudla.
Abangane basula yini?
Basula phansi, itafula nezihlalo.
Ekugcineni abangane bahlala kuphi?
Bahlala esobala ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi.

lessons.title: Abangane ababili
lessons.summary: Nosizwe misses her friend Lulama's birthday party; Lulama thinks she was deceived and they quarrel on the phone, Nosizwe keeps writing to her, Lulama's mother speaks of honesty, and when Nosizwe comes to say sorry the two make peace.
lessons.text:
ULulama noNosizwe bangabangane abakhulu. Bahlala eThekwini. NgoMgqibelo uLulama ugubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa. Umema abangane bakhe endlini yakhe. UNosizwe uthembisa ukuthi uzofika. Kodwa akafiki.

ULulama ulinda isikhathi eside. Ubheka iselula yakhe njalo. Iselula ithule. Ekugcineni uLulama ushayela uNosizwe ngeselula. UNosizwe akaphenduli.

Ngakusasa uNosizwe ushayela uLulama. ULulama uthukuthele. Uthi: "Ungikhohlisile! Uthe uzofika, kodwa awufikanga. Wangikhohlisa." UNosizwe uthi: "Cha, angikukhohlisanga. Lalela..." Kodwa uLulama akalaleli. Bayaxabana ngeselula. Ukuphikisana kwabo kuba kukhulu. Ekugcineni uLulama uvala iselula.

UNosizwe akayeki. Umbhalela ngeselula. Umbhalela futhi. Umbhalela izinsuku ezintathu. Uthi: "Ngicela ungilalele." Uyamphoqelela ukuthi amlalele. Njalo ekuseni uyamphoqelela futhi. UNosizwe uqhubeka ukumphoqelela. ULulama akaphenduli. Ukuxabana kuyamhlupha. Nalokho uNosizwe akubhalayo kuyamhlupha.

Umama kaLulama uyabona ukuthi into ethile iyamhlupha. Uthi: "Ntombi yami, yini ekuhluphayo?" ULulama uthi: "UNosizwe wangikhohlisa. Sixabene." Umama uthi: "Abangane badinga ubuqotho. UNosizwe ungumngane onobuqotho. Kungani ungamlaleli? Ukuphikisana akulungisi lutho."

Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu uNosizwe uyafika endlini kaLulama. Uthi: "Uxolo, Lulama. NgoMgqibelo ugogo wami wagula kakhulu. Ngahamba naye esibhedlela. Iselula yami yafa, ayinamandla." ULulama uyabona ukuthi uNosizwe ukhuluma ngobuqotho. Uthi: "Uxolo nami, Nosizwe. Ngiyaxolisa ngokuthukuthela kwami. Ukuphikisana kwethu kubi."

Abangane ababili bayabuyisana. Bahleka ndawonye futhi. ULulama unika uNosizwe ingxenye yokudla kosuku lokuzalwa. Umama kaLulama uthi: "Kuhle ukuthi nibuyisene. Ukubuyisana kungcono kunokuxabana."

Imibuzo:
UNosizwe uyafika endlini kaLulama ngoMgqibelo na?
Cha, akafiki.
ULulama uthi uNosizwe umkhohlisile na?
Kunjalo, uthi: "Ungikhohlisile!"
UNosizwe umbhalela uLulama na?
Kunjalo, umbhalela izinsuku ezintathu.
Kungani uNosizwe engafikanga?
Akafikanga ngoba ugogo wakhe wagula kakhulu.
UNosizwe uthi uxolo na?
Kunjalo, uthi: "Uxolo, Lulama."
Ekugcineni abangane bayabuyisana na?
Kunjalo, bayabuyisana, bahleka ndawonye futhi.

lessons.title: Isigebengu ebumnyameni
lessons.summary: Sicelo and his sister Ntombizethu of Umlazi light a fire and grill chicken wings for their friends; when the power fails a thief climbs the low wall, breaks a window and takes a bag, so the next week Sicelo locks the door and raises the wall by a metre.
lessons.text:
USicelo nodadewabo, uNtombizethu, bahlala eMlazi. NgoMgqibelo kusihlwa benza umcimbi egcekeni. Abangane babo bayafika. USicelo ubasa umlilo. Ubasa ngezinkuni ezomile. Umlilo uyavutha kahle.

UNtombizethu uletha amaphiko enkukhu. USicelo ubeka amaphiko phezu komlilo. Uwapheka kancane. Amaphiko amnandi kakhulu. Abangane badla amaphiko, bayahleka. Bacela amanye amaphiko. USicelo ubasa umlilo futhi.

Ngemuva kwesikhashana ugesi uyacisha. Ubumnyama bugcwala nxazonke. Kukhanya umlilo kuphela. Ebumnyameni abantu ababoni kahle.

Igceke likaSicelo linodonga oluncane. Ukuphakama kodonga kuyimitha elilodwa nje. Ebumnyameni isigebengu seqa udonga. Isigebengu siya ngasendlini. Siphula iwindi. Singena endlini. Umnyango wendlu awukhiyiwe.

UNtombizethu uzwa umsindo. Ubheka ngasendlini. Ubona isigebengu ngamehlo akhe siphuma ngomnyango. Siphethe isikhwama sikaNtombizethu. Uthi ngezwi elikhulu: "Isigebengu!" Isigebengu siyabaleka, seqa udonga futhi, siyabaleka ebumnyameni. Abangane bonke bayethuka.

Amaphoyisa ayafika. UNtombizethu uthi: "Ngasibona ngamehlo ami. Saphula iwindi." Amaphoyisa athi: "Udonga lwenu luphansi kakhulu. Ukuphakama kwalo kuyimitha elilodwa kuphela. Khuphulani udonga. Futhi khiyani umnyango njalo."

Ngesonto elilandelayo uSicelo ukhuphula udonga. Ulukhuphula ngemitha elilodwa. Manje ukuphakama kodonga kungamamitha amabili. USicelo uthenga ukhiye omusha. Njalo kusihlwa ukhiya umnyango. Uyawuhlola umnyango ngaphambi kokulala. UNtombizethu uthi: "Manje ngiyalala kahle, ngoba umnyango ukhiyiwe. Isigebengu ngeke singene futhi."

Imibuzo:
USicelo ubasa umlilo ngani?
Ubasa umlilo ngezinkuni ezomile.
Ugesi uyacisha na?
Kunjalo, ubumnyama bugcwala nxazonke.
Isigebengu senzani?
Siphula iwindi, singena endlini, sithatha isikhwama.
Ukuphakama kodonga kuyimitha elilodwa na?
Kunjalo, kodwa uSicelo ulukhuphula ngemitha elilodwa.
UNtombizethu ubona isigebengu ngamehlo akhe na?
Kunjalo, usibona ngamehlo akhe.
USicelo ukhiya umnyango njalo na?
Kunjalo, njalo kusihlwa ukhiya umnyango.

lessons.title: Ikilasi lakudala
lessons.summary: In summer Zanokuhle invites the friends who grew up with her in Ulundi to their old fourth-grade classroom; they remember the white teacher who taught them Zulu nouns and share their lives: an editor, a woman in advertising, one on another continent and one who speaks Ndebele.
lessons.text:
UZanokuhle wakhulela oLundi. Wafunda esikoleni esincane lapho. Manje uhlala eGoli. Ehlobo uthola isikhathi sokuphumula. Ufuna ukubona abangane bakhe bakudala. Ubabhalela bonke, uthi: "Wozani ehlobo, sizohlangana ekilasini lethu lakudala."

Ngosuku olushisayo lwasehlobo abangane bayafika esikoleni oLundi. Bonke bakhulela kule ndawo. Bangena ekilasini lebanga lesine. Ikilasi lincane manje kunakuqala. Izihlalo zincane kakhulu. Bonke bayahleka. UZanokuhle uthi: "Safunda lapha ebangeni lesine, singabantwana abancane."

UNontuthuko uthi: "Niyamkhumbula umfundisi wethu webanga lesine?" Bonke bayamkhumbula. Umfundisi wabo wayengumlungu. Lo mlungu wakhuluma isiZulu kahle. Wabafundisa amabizo esiZulu. Wabhala amabizo ebhodini. Wathi: "Umuntu, indlu, isikole: lawa ngamabizo." Bonke bathi lo mlungu wayengumfundisi omuhle kakhulu.

Abangane bakhuluma ngempilo yabo. UNontuthuko ungumhleli wezindaba eThekwini. Njengomhleli, ufunda izindaba eziningi nsuku zonke. Umhleli ukhetha izindaba ezinhle. Omunye umngane usebenza ekukhangiseni. Ukukhangisa kuyamthokozisa, ngoba wenza izithombe ezinhle zezinto ezintsha. Uthi: "Ukukhangisa kufuna imibono emisha."

Omunye umngane uhlala kwelinye izwekazi. Uhlala eLondon. Uthi: "Izwekazi laseYurophu likude, kodwa inhliziyo yami ikhona ekhaya." Omunye umngane washada nendoda ekhuluma isiNdebele. Manje naye ukhuluma isiNdebele. Uyabafundisa amagama ambalwa esiNdebele. Bonke bazama ukukhuluma isiNdebele, bayahleka.

Kusihlwa uZanokuhle uthi: "Sakhulela ndawonye, safunda ekilasini linye. Masihlangane futhi ehlobo elizayo." Bonke bayavuma.

Imibuzo:
UZanokuhle wakhulela kuphi?
Wakhulela oLundi.
Abangane bangena ekilasini lebanga lesine na?
Kunjalo, bangena ekilasini lebanga lesine.
Umfundisi webanga lesine wayengumlungu na?
Kunjalo, wayengumlungu owabafundisa amabizo esiZulu.
UNontuthuko ungumhleli na?
Kunjalo, ungumhleli wezindaba eThekwini.
Omunye umngane uhlala kwelinye izwekazi na?
Kunjalo, uhlala eLondon.

lessons.title: Uhambo lukaThandokuhle
lessons.summary: Thandokuhle, who works at Parliament in Cape Town, travels to Durban for her friend Nonduduzo's birthday; she queues for a bus ticket, a woman minds her bag, a bomb report closes the station for an hour, a drivers' strike awaits her in Durban, and her friend has kept food for her.
lessons.text:
UThandokuhle usebenza ephalamende eKapa. Iphalamende yindawo lapho abaholi bakhuluma khona ngemithetho yezwe. UThandokuhle uthanda umsebenzi wakhe ephalamende. Kodwa ngoMgqibelo umngane wakhe omkhulu, uNonduduzo, unosuku lokuzalwa eThekwini. UThandokuhle ufuna ukuya kuye.

NgoLwesihlanu uThandokuhle uya endaweni yamabhasi. Ufuna ukuthenga ithikithi. Kukhona umugqa omude wabantu. UThandokuhle umi kumugqa. Umugqa uhamba kancane. Eduze nomugqa abantu bayadayisa ukudla. Ukudayisa ukudla lapha kuyabasiza ukuthola imali. Ukudayisa kungumsebenzi wabo. UThandokuhle uthenga isinkwa kowesifazane odayisa ukudla.

UThandokuhle ufuna ukuthenga amanzi. Uthi kowesifazane: "Ngicela ungibonele isikhwama sami." Owesifazane uthi: "Kulungile. Ngizokubonela sona. Ukudayisa kwami kuhamba kancane namuhla." Ngemuva kwemizuzu embalwa uThandokuhle uyabuya. Isikhwama sikhona. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga ngokungibonela isikhwama."

Ngemuva kwalokho amaphoyisa ayafika. Athi: "Kuthiwa kukhona ibhomu lapha! Wonke umuntu kumele aphume!" Abantu bonke bayaphuma. Amaphoyisa afuna ibhomu ihora lonke. Ekugcineni athi: "Alikho ibhomu. Ningangena." UThandokuhle uthi: "Yinhlanhla! Akekho olimele."

UThandokuhle ubuyela kumugqa. Uthenga ithikithi. Ithikithi libiza imali eningi. Unenhlanhla, ngoba ibhasi lisalindile. Uhamba ubusuku bonke. Ekuseni ufika eThekwini. Kodwa namuhla kukhona isiteleka sabashayeli. Abashayeli bezimoto zabagibeli abasebenzi. Isiteleka sivala imigwaqo. UThandokuhle akakwazi ukuthola imoto.

Ushayela uNonduduzo. UNonduduzo uthi: "Ungakhathazeki ngesiteleka. Ubaba wami uzokulanda ngemoto." Inhlanhla iyaqhubeka: ubaba kaNonduduzo uyafika ngokushesha.

UThandokuhle ufika endlini kaNonduduzo emini. Abantu badlile kakade. Kodwa uNonduduzo uthi: "Ngikubekele ukudla. Ngikubekele nekhekhe." UThandokuhle uthi: "Ngiyabonga, mngane wami. Nginenhlanhla ngokuba nomngane onjengawe!"

Imibuzo:
UThandokuhle usebenza kuphi?
Usebenza ephalamende eKapa.
Kukhona umugqa omude na?
Kunjalo, kukhona umugqa omude wabantu.
Owesifazane umbonela isikhwama na?
Kunjalo, umbonela isikhwama sakhe.
Amaphoyisa athola ibhomu na?
Cha, alikho ibhomu.
Kungani uThandokuhle engatholi imoto eThekwini?
Akatholi imoto ngoba kukhona isiteleka sabashayeli.
UNonduduzo umbekele ukudla na?
Kunjalo, umbekele ukudla nekhekhe.
